value: Julia has followed the rumors of a witch who possesses shrinking magic to a remote village. She is left shrunken, while the witch is defeated. Now she has to collect ingredients and battle enemies to gain back her size.

Standard RPGMaker battles with generic mobs, however your character's size ratio affects how much damage you deal, with magic attacks shrinking or draining size.
Depending on your size, different map interactions have different options.
